{{Quote|I.N.S. ''Assessor'', calling stock light freighter. Identify yourself, please.''"<br />"''Ah, ''Assessor'', this is the freighter ''Dorion Discus''.''"<br />"''Stand by, ''Dorion Discus''. Prepare for customs inspection.|Roark Garnet responds to the Imperial Customs Frigate ''Assessor'' hailing the ''Dorion Discus'' in the Thorgeld system|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
Situated in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the '''Thorgeld system''' contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thorgeld I]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the crew of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Dorion Discus]]'' visited the planet, shortly after which the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was confronted by the [[Imperial Customs Frigate]] [[Assessor (Imperial Customs Frigate)|''Assessor'']]. After the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] unsuccessfully attempted to bluff the crew's way out of a [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|customs]] [[Customs Inspector|inspection]] boarding, the ''Dorion Discus'' engaged the ''Assessor'' in [[Space warfare/Legends|combat]] before finally escaping the [[Star system/Legends|system]].

==Description==
The Thorgeld [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> The first [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position of the system was occupied by<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thorgeld I]].<ref name="TRG1" />

==History==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Assessor'', this is ''Dorion Discus''. Ah, negative on customs inspection. We have a priority cargo for the Imperial base on Markon IV. Our priority authorization is filed on Thorgeld.|Roark Garnet attempts to bluff the Imperial Customs Frigate ''Assessor''|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
The crew of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Dorion Discus]]''&mdash;which included the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]]; the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tantos Dree]]; the retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jackson Farseeker]]; and Farseeker's [[Gender/Legends|granddaughter]] and Garnet's daughter, [[Jill Farseeker|Jill]]&mdash;visited Thorgeld I at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Shortly after the ''Dorion Discus'' had left the planet, the [[Imperial Customs Frigate]] [[Assessor (Imperial Customs Frigate)|''Assessor'']] confronted the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in the Thorgeld system and ordered it to stand by for [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|customs]] [[Customs Inspector|inspection]] boarding.<ref name="TRG1" />

In order to stall for [[Time/Legends|time]] while a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump out of the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was being calculated, Garnet contacted the ''Assessor'' and claimed that the ''Dorion Discus'' could not be boarded, bluffing that his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was carrying important cargo for the [[Unidentified Imperial base (Markon IV)|Imperial base]] on [[Markon IV]]. However, the crew of the ''Assessor'' did not fall for Garnet's bluff and fired a warning shot at the smuggler's vessel in response. The ''Dorion Discus'' subsequently engaged the Imperial [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] in [[Space warfare/Legends|combat]] before finally escaping the Thorgeld system for hyperspace.<ref name="TRG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thorgeld system was first indirectly mentioned in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook]] for the first edition of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TRG1" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], named the system and placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
